volume_summary.method: For every wet 0.25-degree cell center inside Version 4 geometry, multiply spherical cell area by the bathymetry-truncated thickness of each OSW depth band; sum by province and band.
volume_summary.precision_boundary: Sampled prismatic integration, not an exact coastline, partial-cell, geodesic-polygon, or native-resolution ocean-volume estimate.

independent_context.interpretation: Scale check only; the published estimate did not calibrate the OSW calculation and does not validate province boundaries or individual province volumes.

boundary: Source-aligned static mean surface ecology, not a current, water mass, material wall, dynamic province diagnosis, heat field, transport, or full-depth ecological occupancy. Bathymetry and water-volume statistics are 0.25-degree cell-center estimates with spherical area weighting and prismatic band integration, not exact polygon integrals, native-resolution volumes, or navigational products.
